concepts.definition: ODD is a graph-native product-authoring method for GTL/ABG domain products. Its structural requirements include typed domain assets, named graph functions, a published catalog, an operative GTL module, ABG execution ownership, constructive evaluation, history-derived queries, and automation explainable through lawful manual traversal. It supplies product shape; each product supplies asset meanings, proof lanes and query overlays.

grounding.quote: ODD method is the graph-native product-authoring method for building GTL/ABG domain products.
- each product defines its own asset meanings, proof lanes, and query overlays

concepts.label: ODD method

conditions: Applies to every ODD product over GTL/ABG.
concepts.definition: The method-level homeostasis loop carries intent lineage and model synthesis through observation to the next lawful action. Its four operative functions are synthesize_model, eval_gap, evaluate_next and evaluate_action.

grounding.quote:
Every ODD product over GTL/ABG must preserve one constructive evaluation loop
from intent lineage and model synthesis through observation to next lawful
action.

concepts.label: Constructive evaluation and yield loop

concepts.definition: The selected Product outcome under STDO-UP-013 and any admitted bounded prerequisite or experiment basis supply the loop's external authority. They are preserved as exact references, not authored or enlarged by models, gaps, assurance, ledgers or projections.

grounding.quote:
The selected Product outcome under `STDO-UP-013` is external authority for this
loop.

concepts.label: Selected Product outcome and admitted bounded basis

concepts.definition: Named loop carriers retain distinct meanings: IntentLineage is admitted source intent and lineage from human, imported source, prior product, intent engine or prior synthesized intent, backed by the ABG event log; ProductAssetModel is desired and known typed asset truth synthesized from lineage, prior model and admitted product truth, published through admitted events and product projections, not runtime fact or action authority; Worksite is the observable workspace, runtime archive, transform assets, product asset root, profile and file/process state; RuntimeEventLog is append-only admitted runtime fact; RuntimeProjection is replay-derived runtime state over that log and execution basis; ObservationSnapshot is read-only runtime truth plus construction-relevant worksite facts; GapPressureRow expresses missing, partial, blocked, waiting or ambiguous asset/evidence pressure relative to the model. TargetObligationBinding exactly binds pressure to selected outcome, admitted prerequisite/experiment basis, target assets, required roles, evidence and admissible graph outcomes. ActionCatalog publishes lawful functions, vectors, targets, inputs and eligible outcomes. PriorityProjection deterministically ranks bound lawful actions under visible policy. ConstructionIntent is the admitted selected action for one bounded graph invocation preserving binding authority references. AdmittedEvidence comprises admitted worker, process, product, execution, materialization, liveness and postflight evidence, not worker self-closure. EdgeFulfillmentLedger carries evidence and convergence for an edge attempt/version. NextActionProjection reads dispatch basis and current truth to select only lawful next graph action.

grounding.quote: The objects have these method-level meanings:

concepts.label: Distinct constructive-loop carriers

concepts.definition: NextActionBasis is a dispatch sum type, not a controller: initial_selection(IntentLineage, ProductAssetModel), or post_yield_resume, post_close_graph_continuation, post_retry, post_repair, post_reenter, post_reprice or post_block derived from an admitted EdgeClosureDecision. post_reprice records a constitutional re-entry request without action-selection authority.

grounding.quote: `post_reprice` records a re-entry request and carries no action-selection authority.

concepts.label: NextActionBasis

concepts.definition: The four function contracts are: synthesize_model(IntentLineage, prior ProductAssetModel, admitted product truth) returns ProductAssetModel; eval_gap(ProductAssetModel, RuntimeEventLog, RuntimeProjection, Worksite) returns ObservationSnapshot and GapPressureRow; evaluate_next(NextActionBasis, fresh eval_gap, TargetObligationBinding, ActionCatalog, Policy) returns PriorityProjection, NextActionProjection and selected_action; evaluate_action(ConstructionIntent, AdmittedEvidence, TargetObligationBinding, Policy) returns EdgeFulfillmentLedger and EdgeClosureDecision.

grounding.quote:
The loop has one model synthesis function and three distinct evaluation
functions.

concepts.label: Four distinct loop functions

Its predicate concerns lawful issuance for the subject, current basis and mandate; edge fitness and Product completion have separate predicates. Yield is a lawful iteration boundary preserving the current edge, admitted progress/waiting and replay-visible resume basis without adding a failure classification.

concepts.definition: Agentic conformance has two separate halves: an F_P real-work walkthrough proving the constitutional process followable and an F_D deterministic artifact-admission gate proving each produced act conforms. Method defect and agent error are provenance-bearing causal findings, not verdict aliases. SPEC_METHOD.md owns general constitutional process and TICKET_METHOD.md artifact admission.

concepts.label: Agentic walkthrough and artifact gate

concepts.definition: A scenario is a graph-native proving surface, beyond test documentation. Declared scenarios and use cases are preferred sources of significant proving paths because they pressure feature intent and design decisions.

grounding.quote: Scenarios are graph-native proving surfaces.

concepts.label: Scenario bundle

concepts.definition: Posts are the repository's commentary layer for analysis, criticism, proposed change, handoff and confidence repricing. grounding.quote: Posts are not constitutional truth. They are working commentary that may later influence specification or design.

concepts.label: Commentary post

concepts.definition: Post categories are REVIEW for critique of code/spec/design/posts; STRATEGY for proposed technical or methodological direction; GAP for precise insufficiency/contradiction; SCHEMA for data/event/interface/contract shape; HANDOFF for bounded context or task-state transfer; MATRIX for explicit comparison of decision options. Discussion states are Draft (author shaping), Open (active published discussion) and Closed (concluded discussion).

Bind, Acquire,

concepts.definition: Reference Frame Method is a substrate-neutral engagement meta-method for finite actors constructing and using bounded reasoning/execution contexts over changing work. It owns frame declaration, activation, evaluation, basis, relation, result, coverage, revision and qualification in urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation under its exact publication basis. grounding.quote:
This method governs how finite actors construct and use bounded reasoning or
execution contexts over a changing body of work.

concepts.label: Reference Frame Method

concepts.definition: An evaluation is a declared question with known predicate, admissible evidence, decision authority and, for material action, operation authority. It may request judgment, prediction, construction, comparison, proof, refusal, classification or action recommendation. An evaluation family groups questions sharing the material-relation manifold, authority basis and result binding/refinement of the one core algebra; similar wording does not establish family identity.

grounding.quote:
An evaluation family groups questions that require the same material relation
manifold, authority basis, and result binding or refinement of that one algebra.
Similar wording does not prove that two evaluations belong to the same family.

concepts.label: Evaluation and evaluation family

concepts.definition: Workspace is the bounded material body reasoned over or acted upon, potentially including constitutional sources, assets, designs, implementations, tools, runtime state, evidence, history, external dependencies and human decisions. It is broader than a repository and distinct from an actor's acquired view.

grounding.quote:
Observed state can defeat a stale summary; the summary cannot change the state.
External effects require observations from their owning surfaces.

concepts.label: Workspace in frame evaluation

concepts.definition: Basis identifies the exact evaluated state, including every version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration and evidence coordinate whose change can alter evaluation. It may be immutable or moving.

grounding.quote: A **basis** identifies the exact state against which an evaluation is made.

concepts.label: Evaluation basis

concepts.definition: A relation is material relative to an evaluation when lawful change can change its result, invalidate its basis, alter admissible evidence or change who may perform or decide a material operation. The same relation may be irrelevant elsewhere.

grounding.quote:
Materiality is evaluation-relative. A relation may be material in one frame and
irrelevant in another.

concepts.label: Evaluation-relative material relation

concepts.definition: Material-relation manifold is the finite jointly interpretable set of variables, entities, identities, states, relations, invariants, authorities, observations and exclusions needed by an evaluation family. It is a bounded relation space with potentially overlapping coordinate charts, without requiring geometric mathematics or a runtime manifold abstraction.

grounding.quote:
`Manifold` names a bounded relation space with potentially overlapping
coordinate charts. It does not require geometric mathematics or a runtime
manifold abstraction.

concepts.label: Material-relation manifold

concepts.definition: Coordinate is the complete local position for interpreting a value, event, decision, observation or action, including evaluation-required basis, identity, lineage, input, evidence and authority. Topology is the frame-visible relation structure at a basis among material entities, capabilities, authorities, lifecycle spaces, adjacencies and seams; it need not be the whole workspace topology.

grounding.quote:
A **coordinate** is the complete local position from which a value, event,
decision, observation, or action is interpreted.

**Topology** is the relation structure among the material entities,
capabilities, authorities, lifecycle state spaces, adjacencies, and seams
visible to a frame at one basis.

concepts.label: Coordinates and topology

concepts.definition: Evidence is the exact observation or artifact admitted for evaluation, carrying provenance, subject identity, basis and scope. Assertion provenance justifies the expected predicate; execution provenance identifies the acquired subject and result.

grounding.quote:
**Evidence** is the exact observation or artifact admitted for an evaluation.
Evidence carries provenance, subject identity, basis, and scope.

concepts.label: Frame evidence

concepts.definition: Frame authority vocabulary separates human frame-set authority declaring/accepting the set; semantic owner of meaning; evaluation role permitted to evaluate; owner-issued operation grant for construction, transformation, admission, publication or mutation; decision role permitted to dispose results; and actor identity of the human, agent, tool or process doing work.

grounding.quote:
- **semantic authority**: the owner of meaning for a material relation;
- **evaluation authority**: the role permitted to perform an evaluation;

concepts.label: Frame authority kinds and actor identity

concepts.definition: Frame disjointness is absence of shared material variables, coordinates, evidence or result dependencies for declared evaluations. Evaluation independence is separate activation without consuming or influencing another's unclosed working results, permitting shared subjects/manifolds and later conjunction of closed results. Assurance independence is claim-relative separation of authorship, evidence acquisition, reference exposure, actor and configuration as required by the governing assurance law.

grounding.quote:
Disjoint frames need not be independently evaluated, and independently
activated evaluations need not be disjoint. The unqualified word
`independent` does not establish any of these relations by itself.

concepts.label: Disjointness, evaluation independence and assurance independence

concepts.definition: Capability envelope declares competence, context capacity, tools, access, applicable evaluation/assurance independence and configuration required for activation and evaluation. The same frame may fit one actor and fail to fit another.

grounding.quote:
A **capability envelope** declares the competence, context capacity, tools,
access, applicable evaluation- or assurance-independence conditions, and
configuration required to activate a frame and perform its evaluations.

concepts.label: Actor capability envelope

concepts.definition: A reference frame is a finite evaluation contract specifying attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and results for one evaluation family at a stated basis. Its optional formal description F=<Q,B,M,C,I,A,E,X,R,J,K,D> names evaluation family; workspace/topology basis; material manifold; coordinate/equality law; invariants; authority; admissible evidence/provenance; exclusions/prohibited assumptions; shared result algebra/refinements; invalidation/rechart conditions; capability envelope; and optional inter-frame dependencies, overlaps, inputs and outputs. The tuple is a relation specification, not a required schema or runtime carrier.

grounding.quote:
This tuple specifies the relation. It is not a required schema or runtime
carrier.

concepts.label: Reference frame

concepts.definition: Activated frame binds a declaration to one exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary. A reusable declaration is not evidence of a correct particular activation.

grounding.quote:
An **activated frame** binds one frame declaration to an exact evaluation,
workspace subject, basis, actor, and evidence acquisition boundary. A reusable
frame declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct.

concepts.label: Activated frame

concepts.definition: Frame set is the human-declared family available for a governed outcome/workspace, potentially including intentional overlaps, alternatives, specialists, broad exploration and separately activated assurance. Active frame configuration is the activations and declared result relations for one evaluation/decision, containing one or several disjoint, overlapping or composed frames. Neither a partition, tree, stack nor exhaustive ontology is required.

grounding.quote:
A frame set is not required to be a partition, tree, stack, or exhaustive
ontology.

An **active frame configuration** is the set of frame activations and declared
result relations used for one evaluation or decision.

concepts.label: Frame set and active configuration

concepts.definition: A lens is a reusable question family across frame configurations, such as authority, capability/reuse, time, transport or proof. Roles allocate responsibility/authority, personas change approach/salience, abstractions hide/contract detail and components are subject parts. These can aid frames but none is a frame by identity alone; a component can span frames and a frame can span components.

grounding.quote:
A lens becomes a frame only when it is instantiated with a bounded evaluation,
basis, material manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra, and capability
envelope.

Each may help construct or activate a frame. None is a reference frame by
identity alone. One component may appear in several frames, and one frame may
cross several components.

concepts.label: Lenses, roles, personas, abstractions and components

concepts.definition: Frame method functions are distinct relations: declare(human authority, workspace, outcome, practices, capabilities)->frame_set; activate(frame, evaluation, subject, basis, actor)->activated_frame or activation_refusal; evaluate(activated_frame, admissible evidence)->result+evidence+residuals; conjoin(decision rule, frame results)->core_result+retained_conflicts+residuals; translate(source frame, target frame, value/evidence, mapping)->translated_value or declared_loss or refusal; audit_coverage(workspace, outcome, evaluation inventory, frame set)->coverage_ledger; revise(frame set, new evidence, failures, capability/topology change)->proposed_frame_set_delta.

grounding.quote:
These signatures describe method relations. They do not require callable
software interfaces.

concepts.label: Frame method relation signatures

concepts.definition: The four distinct forms of joint frame participation are independently activated co-evaluation, result conjunction, evidence/coordinate translation and material composition. More general frame relations are disjoint (no shared material dependency), overlapping (shared variables/evidence/entities), complementary (different evaluations inform one decision), alternative (same claim under declared capability/evidence conditions), refinement (resolve an aggregated distinction), restriction (lawful domain subset), translated (declared coordinate map), temporally successive (changed basis), composed (one governed evaluation/action), and governing/subordinate (declared inherited constraints where real authority/decomposition exists).

grounding.quote: Frames participate together through four distinct relations.

No one relation is the default universal frame topology. A project declares
only the relations needed for its evaluations and coverage claims.

concepts.label: Joint participation and frame relation types

Material changes to any member may invalidate coverage. The coverage ledger minimally records exact evaluation, materiality provenance, subject/basis, selected capable frames, actor envelope, semantic authority, operation grant where effectful (otherwise none), decision authority, evidence/provenance, dependencies, coverage status and residual/exclusion/re-entry condition.

constraints.statement: Material selection stays within the exact selected outcome or admitted bounded prerequisite/experiment. Graph/edge closure is evidence toward, not Product/release acceptance. Select no further material work when the outcome is accepted, prerequisite discharged, experiment decision resolved, another admitted terminal condition reached, or governing basis/bound exhausted, rejected, withdrawn, superseded, repriced away or falsified. Reprice requests constitutional re-entry without performing repricing or choosing a successor outcome. Stop returns the selected outcome/bounded-task predicate: admissible completion evidence satisfies it; demonstrated unmet required condition falsifies it; exhaustion/withdrawal without deciding evidence leaves indeterminate; invalid evaluation basis or established scope/capability diagnosis retains its core value. Preserve stop reason, performance, effects and unresolved obligations, and assess stopping lawfulness separately. Neither stopping nor lawful no-action proves completion.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced core stop contract and STDO-UP-013 owner are not supplied.

They may share underlying libraries, but they must not share
authority:

constraints.statement: synthesize_model may update desired/known typed asset truth but must not observe Worksite, admit construction intent, select/invoke/close work. eval_gap compares model with observed reality and emits only observation and pressure, read-only, without admitting intent or choosing/invoking/closing work. evaluate_next binds/ranks published lawful actions matching gap and governing basis but does not admit intent or classify prior action; it consumes admitted closure classification. evaluate_action evaluates only the just-taken action, returning close/yield/retry/repair/re-enter/reprice/block without admitting intent, invoking work or selecting next action. Each invocation applies its declared inputs, output predicate and authority under Contract application. Designs, tickets, modules and proofs must name the particular function, not merely 'evaluator'.

grounding.quote:
A correctly observed missing
asset can satisfy this characterization while its Product obligation remains
unfulfilled.

constraints.statement: Missing, partial, blocked, waiting and ambiguous are observed domain conditions, not verdict aliases. eval_gap assesses whether the pressure accurately characterizes asset/evidence X against model M at observation O: supporting observation satisfies; demonstrated mismatch falsifies; undecided support is indeterminate; invalid model/observation basis or established scope/capability shortfall uses the corresponding diagnosis. Preserve pressure, evidence, performance and uncertainty independently of Product obligation fulfillment.

grounding.quote:
`ConstructionIntent` must cite the
lineage, selected action, and `TargetObligationBinding` that preserve the exact
selected Product outcome and any admitted bounded-basis refs.

A broad edge cannot satisfy a specific product or evidence gap unless the
binding proves that edge is the lawful action for those exact assets.

constraints.statement: Source intent seeds the model; current construction intent is synthesized against model and observed gap and admitted in a distinct step after evaluate_next selects an already-published graph function/vector. Intent cannot invent graph actions. Before every constructive invocation bind current gap to exact assets and obligations through selected outcome reference, optional admitted prerequisite/experiment reference, pressure, targets, roles and evidence. ConstructionIntent cites lineage, selected action and binding preserving those exact authority references.

grounding.quote:
Closure can only use W through L.
Eval can only judge W through L.
Eval only affects traversal after its own L/E admission.

An evaluator may attend only to admitted ledger rows reachable through declared
lineage, predecessor refs, target binding, policy, and the relevant event-log
cursor.

constraints.statement: Filesystem, process output, logs, worker artifacts and product files are observations, gaining authority only through typed evidence admission and ledger/decision folding. F_P acts in W; admission records L; E orders/anchors entries with predecessor references; Ev reads a declared L snapshot and its output is F_P work admitted back into L/E before affecting closure, routing or traversal. Every closure-relevant F_P callout doing work needs admission. W changes need not satisfy contract; admitted L claims need not encompass all W. Evaluator attention is restricted to admitted rows reachable by declared lineage, predecessors, binding, policy and event cursor; outside workspace facts, prose, archives, summaries or controller memory are excluded. Corrections append or supersede, never rewrite governed history.

conditions: Current observations contradict a previously admitted claim.

grounding.quote: L cannot overrule contrary current observations of W.

constraints.statement: The evidence-admission owner admits supported observation and affected currentness uncertainty into L/E under the existing evidence contract before dependent closure or selection. Consumers read through L; unresolved interpretation prevents reuse of the affected claim as current support. Recording observation supplies no verdict; admitted interpretation invalidates affected claims through the declared re-entry relation. Missing admission supplies no currentness proof and immutability cannot justify discarding contrary observation. Historical truth remains bound to its stated admitted basis.
constraints.uncertainty: The declared re-entry relation and evidence contract are referenced but not fully supplied.

grounding.quote: `evaluate_next` must be total.

constraints.statement: evaluate_next ranks only published lawful catalog actions. An unpublished desired action yields typed no-action, never a broad executive graph/local-script fallback. initial_selection uses current model/gap/binding/catalog/policy. post_yield_resume resumes or yields the same edge using replay-visible resume truth without classifying failure. post_close_graph_continuation may select the next edge after closure or no action when graph-complete. For post_retry/post_repair/post_reenter/post_block: select a higher-priority lawful action if available; else follow the current edge if lawful; else reprice or block if authority missing; otherwise block with typed no-action. Default graph following remains an evaluate_next decision. Unresolved post_reprice must return typed no-action; work can be evaluated again only after separate lawful re-entry admits an exact outcome/bounded basis through new initial_selection or basis-bearing resume.

grounding.quote:
admissible reliance
is not itself edge fitness, and a smaller post-action target cannot replace
the predicate.

A false/open projection retains
the failed or unresolved result and its reason, rather than treating every
open edge as falsified.

constraints.statement: Raw artifacts, worker reports, process success or CLI summaries cannot close edges. Closure folds AdmittedEvidence into EdgeFulfillmentLedger and EdgeClosureDecision. evaluate_action applies Contract application to admitted-evidence reliance for the exact pre-action binding/evidence-set predicate and core conjunction over its obligations, retaining original domain assessments. The ledger records counts, obligation rows, materialization/liveness/admission references and edge_converged; convergence projects the complete closure predicate, never counts/liveness/artifact presence alone. True requires satisfied closure. False/open retains failure, uncertainty or diagnosis. Neither ledger nor closure disposition selects next action; evaluate_next uses admitted decision plus fresh gap truth.

grounding.quote:
Each result therefore has one verdict on its own
explicit predicate; the disposition determines permitted subsequent treatment.

constraints.statement: Every closure disposition carries reproducible basis/reasons. Lawful-decision satisfaction requires F_D/ABG/product admission; an evaluator proposal supplies none. close requires satisfied complete closure; demonstrated obligation violation remains falsified under any other disposition, including yield. Undecided closure is indeterminate only absent deciding falsification, invalid basis or out-of-frame contribution under core conjunction. Unusable basis is invalid_basis; outside admitted action domain is out_of_frame. Unperformed evaluation is not_performed; unknown evaluation performance is unconfirmed; worker non-start/execution/effects are separate facts. Preserve predicates, original disposition, obligation assessments, performance, evidence, effects and reasons. Decision satisfaction can coexist with failed/unresolved fitness. Lawful typed no-action may satisfy selection but never Product completion. For closure/selection decisions, bound-authority and contract evidence satisfies, established violation falsifies, undecided mandate/support is indeterminate, and invalid interpretation or established scope/capability limit retains diagnosis. Labels alone cannot decide results or relabel obligation failure as Product success.
constraints.uncertainty: Core legal performance/verdict pairs and conjunction details remain externally owned.

grounding.quote:
Liveness observes activity, inactivity, process state, and interruption. It can
support yield or liveness interruption. It cannot by itself declare semantic
failure, semantic closure, or requirement non-satisfaction.

constraints.statement: Yield preserves lawful same-edge iteration with admitted progress/waiting and replay-visible resume; it is neither retry, block, timeout nor local CLI looping, and adds no failure classification to retained assessments. Liveness alone cannot establish semantic failure/closure/non-satisfaction. evaluate_action may issue conceptual repair/re-enter dispositions; evaluate_next alone selects published graph actions realizing them from admitted closure truth, not local string retry branches. Public queries/gaps views may render read-only gap, closure and next-action outputs but must not append events, invoke workers, admit intent, run evaluate_action or choose traversal themselves.

exceptions: Recovery need not acquire complete history or repeat still-valid evaluations.

grounding.quote:
Resolve material unknown or partial
effects before a dependent repeat. A lost invocation response supplies neither
`not_started` nor `completed` evidence.

A broken predecessor
chain is non-replayable at the carrier level and therefore fails A13.

constraints.statement: Every closure/selection is reproducible from runtime log, execution basis, event-backed lineage, model publication basis/events, exact outcome/bounded refs, gap, binding, catalog, admitted evidence, ledger, closure decision, next-action basis and visible policy; failure indicates hidden state. Every governing admitted/replay carrier carries causal predecessor references: outcome/bounded refs->binding; lineage->model->gap->binding->priority->selected NextActionProjection->ConstructionIntent->evidence->ledger->closure->NextActionBasis->post-action NextActionProjection. Observation is the model/runtime/worksite read boundary before gap. Both projection occurrences must be predecessor-reachable without external joins; selected intent preserves authority. Recovery applies workspace/context and resumed-action Contract application, acquiring sufficient reachable ledger, current basis and invalidators; current admission/replay reconstruct control and material unknown/partial effects are resolved before dependent repeat.

exceptions: Opaque internals may use local control flow solely to compute one bounded action's internal result.

grounding.quote:
Once a refinement is
published as graph structure, it is governed by the loop recursively.

constraints.statement: When an outer vector is refined into published inner vectors, each inner boundary obeys all four functions with its own visible model, gap, binding, action, evidence, ledger, closure and next projection. Opaque implementation must not publish, dispatch, retry, repair, re-enter or close graph work as hidden control. ABG owns runtime truth, replay, graph-call lifecycle, actor/process supervision, continuation and re-entry mechanics; Product owns asset/catalog meaning, gap interpretation and priority policy. Design Module Method governs modules within that split without creating module-local eval_gap/evaluate_next/evaluate_action authorities.

conditions: A ticket, design, module or proof touches synthesis, evaluation, traversal, selection, intent, worker invocation, admission, fulfillment, liveness, closure, re-entry, query or live proof.
exceptions: Unchanged accepted relations cite their accepted basis rather than being re-proven.

grounding.quote:
The axiom family does not authorize
horizontal realization growth, create Product work, or widen the selected
outcome.

The implementation is correct only when the next work decision is derived from
that equation, `U` remains causally reachable through the target binding and
construction intent, and no other path can decide what work happens next.

constraints.statement: Causally applicable axioms and the equation control acceptance for the selected outcome/affected published boundary.
